title: It's come a LONG way!
author: BSwayzeYo
selftext:
I'm only a couple of weeks away from releasing on Steam. It's been a long time coming and it's going to be a huge relief to finally get this game in a place where people can play it!

Fishing Nooks has taught me so much about ai game dev and I have 3 other projects in the works as well. I don't care if people call my game slop. I know that it is not slop and it is crafted with incredible care, attention, and passion. Cheers fellow ai game devs! Show me your projects!

  
I've built this using a harnessed Claude Opus 5.5.

comments.author: YellowQuestOfficial
comments.body: is claude able to just one shot the animations? or do you make the assets first then use a skill or...curious because I've tried basic animations and ended up just having to do it by hand.

replies.author: BSwayzeYo
replies.body: I use ChatGPT to make a character visual I like and then I give it back to ChatGPT to make a sheet of angles of that character and then I give it to Claude and ask it tell me what tools it needs to make good 3D animations that are free to use in my commercial project and then tell Claude to go online and get what it needs. Then I wait for a result and tweak a lot. Nothing good has ever come easy that's for sure. And I use superpowers. It's a damn solid skill that helps get the best results possible.

replies.author: amIDreaming32
replies.body: If you have codex, you can tell claude to setup and use codex headless image gen instead, with no hassle of going back and forth with with harnesses

replies.author: Level3Super
replies.body: which price you using for ChatGPT?

replies.author: Level3Super
replies.body: Thanks, what about the level design? I'm thinking of a doing side scrolling game

replies.author: BSwayzeYo
replies.body: I used public satellite data for my lake shapes. And I just hand drew the lake shape shoreline for Beaver’s Pond which is my own fictional design. I haven’t attempted a side scroller design before but if would honestly ask your LLM’s for the top 30 aspects of level design in a side scroller and then ask for the best tools to help with those designs and go from there.

replies.author: YellowQuestOfficial
replies.body: very interesting! maybe I should give this claude/codex combo a try. thanks for the reply.

comments.author: Maganda_
comments.body: Added this game to my wishlist .

replies.author: BSwayzeYo
replies.body: Wow!! Thank you for the interest and support! 🎣🎣
